Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4432); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol:--Moloch.
BiblicalUsage: Moloch is the Greek form of Molek, and Stephen throws it in the Sanhedrin's face. Their fathers carried the tabernacle of Moloch and the star of their god Remphan, and God carried them away beyond Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Stephen names the old idolatry because it never died: the same worship that followed Israel into the wilderness was still standing in the room.
